content:
Two-headed **leeches** [1] are creatures seen in the *Fallout* TV series and in *Fallout 76* in the form of superb bait.
## Background[]

Leeches are aquatic parasitic worms that feed on blood. Historically, leeches were used in medicine for bloodletting. Leeches were also used in Appalachia for fishing.

## Characteristics[]

This post-War leech species has mutated and now has two heads for it to suck blood from its victims with.

## In the series[]

After the Ghoul submerges Lucy in the water as gulper bait and takes her out, he picks a leech off her and feeds it to the dog.

## Appearances[]

Leeches appear in the *Fallout* TV series episode "The Head" and in the *Gone Fission* update for *Fallout 76*. They are also mentioned in *Fallout 4*. [2] 

Giant leeches were to appear in *Van Buren*, the canceled version of *Fallout 3* by Black Isle Studios. [3]
